description: Locked before the validation program was run. These choices are independent of P12 formal results. Population evaluation is an exact enumeration of fresh frames, independent of calibration training frames.

true.context: Z is sign of a noisy known pilot. Conditional on branch R, P(Z=R)=p_context_sign_correct. Bit 0 denotes positive sign.
true.target: One block amplitude label U with P(U=R)=p_target_amplitude_label_correct. Given C,R, each sign bit T_j equals C_j xor R with probability p_target_bpsk_sign_correct. All noises mutually conditionally independent. Y=(U,T1,T2,T3). U is a shared block measurement counted once.
true.training: Independent known-pilot calibration pairs (Z,V) only. Given R, independently P(V=R)=p_training_probe_sign_correct. R is latent, never supplied to the fitting routine. The target Y is never available for channel MSE.

methods.exact_soft: True posterior P(R|Z) by Bayes from the explicit true law.
methods.context_map_hard: Take the MAP branch given Z once, ties choose branch 0; reuse that one branch for estimation and target likelihood.
methods.physical_soft: Explicit misspecified pilot-sensor model with correct branch prior, gains and target likelihood, but higher assumed sign-pilot reliability.
methods.trainable_attention: Two-dimensional one-hot queries for Z; two trainable scores in key k0 and reference key k1=(0,0), ordinary unscaled dot-product softmax over branches. Fit both keys' score differences from observable calibration probes V by constrained maximum marginal likelihood. Estimate p(V=0|Z) by frequencies, invert known probe likelihood, clip to [1/1000,999/1000], and set k0[z]=logit(fitted weight). If Z missing use weight 1/2. Values H_r and per-branch joint word/target likelihoods fixed for all policies.
methods.rng: Python random.Random; draw R then Z then V with three comparisons against random() per calibration frame

metrics_and_rules.mse: E_true[(H-estimate(Z))^2]. Real scalar embeds in complex 1x1.
metrics_and_rules.ber: Expected Hamming error on the two equiprobable information bits divided by two. Each method uses bitwise MAP from its own joint decoder scores.
metrics_and_rules.bler: Probability of incorrect two-bit message (equivalently codeword) for block MAP from the same scores.
metrics_and_rules.decoding: Use all four legal codewords. Scores are sum over retained branches of weight(R|Z) * P(C) * P(Y|R,C). Never plug channel mean into these decoders. Bit ties choose zero; equally scoring block tie chooses first in codeword order.
checks: identical branch means and 3-branch barycentric equality
reversed weights in noiseless two-branch example
opposite plug-in BER and MSE in given noiseless example, full mixture decoder uses target amplitude
complex Frobenius and Hermitian total covariance with branch-internal variation
TV-diameter bound with value errors and exact sharp two-point case
finite benchmark pointwise projection and comparison to hard, decision margins and common-list omission
metrics_and_rules.timing: Report deterministic counts for complete dense scoring per (z,y) and timing separately: median over 5 passes of 1200 end-to-end float joint-score/bit/block decisions for each policy on the same cycling input sequence. Report hardware/runtime. Time is descriptive, no latency-based acceptance test.
metrics_and_rules.report_all: No seed selection, tuning, holdout sampling or significance testing. Record per-seed outputs. Auxiliary omission example restricts every model to the same first two codewords after full joint is computed.
